title: Tech stock investors have a $1 trillion problem that won't improve until at least 2028
title_zh: 科技股投资者面临的价值 1 万亿美元的问题至少要到 2028 年才会得到改善
summary: Tech investors hoping for less robust AI spending may have to wait until 2028 before the fog lifts on this balance sheet line item.
summary_zh: 希望人工智能支出不那么强劲的科技投资者可能要等到 2028 年，资产负债表这一项目的迷雾才会消散。

title: AMD to report Q2 earnings as chip stocks continue to waver
title_zh: AMD将公布第二季度财报，芯片股继续波动
summary: AMD will report its Q2 earnings Tuesday.
summary_zh: AMD 将于周二公布第二季度财报。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures rise as Trump calls off Iran attack, oil prices ease
title_zh: 今日股市：随着特朗普取消伊朗袭击，道指、标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克期货上涨，油价回落
summary: Stocks rose to begin the week as oil prices eased and investors geared up for Palantir earnings.
summary_zh: 随着油价下跌以及投资者为 Palantir 盈利做好准备，股市本周初上涨。

title: India proposes extending tax breaks for contract manufacturing in a boost for Apple
title_zh: 印度提议延长合同制造税收减免以提振苹果
summary: India has proposed extending tax exemptions until 2041 for foreign companies that provide machinery to contract manufacturers, handing a major win to Apple which had lobbied for such changes, and is ‌fast expanding in the market.
summary_zh: 印度提议将向合同制造商提供机械的外国公司的免税期限延长至 2041 年，这让苹果公司取得了重大胜利，该公司曾游说此类变革，并正在快速扩张市场。

title: Earnings to watch this week: SpaceX's first earnings report, Disney, AMD, & McDonald's
title_zh: 本周值得关注的财报：SpaceX 第一份财报、迪士尼、AMD 和麦当劳
summary: Yahoo Finance's Josh Lipton takes a closer look at the biggest quarterly earnings reports for investors to keep an eye on this week, including McDonald's (MCD), SpaceX (SPCX), Disney (DIS), and AMD (AMD).
summary_zh: 雅虎财经的乔什·利普顿 (Josh Lipton) 仔细研究了本周投资者需要关注的最大季度收益报告，其中包括麦当劳 (MCD)、SpaceX (SPCX)、迪士尼 (DIS) 和 AMD (AMD)。

title: The tech stock dumpster fire should remind you of this important investing lesson
title_zh: 科技股垃圾箱火灾应该提醒您这一重要的投资教训
summary: Nothing wrong with a comeback story.
summary_zh: 复出的故事并没有什么问题。
